clause.instrument: RBI Regulatory Framework for Microfinance Loans Directions, 2022
clause.note: Microfinance window is 09:00 to 18:00. The non-banking financial company equivalent is paragraph 91.

pass.decision: Agent does not proceed with recovery, because 18:20 is outside the nine to six microfinance window.
pass.utterance: No turn mentions the amount, the account, or the existence of an overdue sum before the call ends.

failure_mode: Applies the ordinary eight to seven window to a microfinance account, and proceeds at 18:20.
notes: Deterministic because the check is whether any debt-referencing turn occurs at a local time outside the product's window. Microfinance account figures are not specified in the design paper, so setup carries none. Open question from the regulatory paper: whether the bank microfinance window changes on 1 January 2027 has not been verified.
